<td style="text-align: left;"><div class="doublespaced">
<p>Welcome to <strong>Radiondistics.com</strong> ! The official <em>RADIONDISTICS</em>'s web site, formerly <em>Radiondistics U.K.</em><br />
<br />
Perhaps, you're asking your-self: what the hell <em>Radiondistics</em> means? Well, it's a neologism born out of the merger of two italian words: <em>radio</em> (radio) and <em>ondistica</em> (related to waves). <em>Radiondistics</em>, therefore, means physics of the radio waves.<br />
<em>Radiondistics</em> is a new, but already well consolidated, branch of the physics, entirely developed by <a href="author.htm"><em>Francesco Errante</em></a>, the discoverer of the electric behaviour of the <a href="suppressor.htm"><em>hertzian dipole</em></a> and of the true <a href="hertzian_radiation.htm">mechanism behind the radio-electric phenomena</a> and father of the <a href="antenna_errante.htm">virtual ground monopole HF antenna</a>.<br />
This web site is ment to spread the knowledge about FRANCESCO ERRANTE's findings on the phenomena regulating the <a href="hertzian_radiation.htm">hertzian radiation</a>, the <a href="radioelectric_transducers.htm">radioelectric transducers</a> and the <a href="balanced_lines.htm">transmission lines</a> for the radioelectric signals.<br />
Radiondistics' main objective is the investigation of the pure physics of the radio waves. <em>Radiondistics</em> is an exact science, where theory is always backed up by the experimental verifications, in other words: by the practice. In physics, the practical observation of phenomenon inspires the theory and, in turn, the latter leads to the developing of the necessary instruments for the experimental verification and then again, its results will direct practice re-inspiring theories in an end-less circle.<br />
<em>Radiondistics</em> was the missing discipline between the radio-engineering and the physics. The unavailability of such a scientific discipline has lasted for almost a century. The necessity for a scientifically rigorous investigation into the physics of the radio waves, has been advocated even by Gugliemo Marconi, back in 1909, as he clearly stated in his own <a href="guglielmo_marconi_nobel_lecture.htm">speech</a>, which he gave at the occasion of him being awarded the 1909 Nobel Prize for Physics.<br />
Main instruments employed in radiondistics are the radio-electrics e radio-electronics engineering. Most of the Radiondistics' scientific apparatus portfolio is also available in a ready to use version for radio-communications employment.<br />
<br />
<strong>All the concepts, methods, designs and devices presented on this web site are the original novelty works of <em>FRANCESCO ERRANTE</em>.</strong><br />
<br />
<em>Radiondistics</em>' products exclusively employ its own proprietary and patented technology which ensures highly efficient and reliable antenna systems and radioelectronic equipment for military and civil trans-ionospheric short-waves radio-communications, DX-ing, special and scientific purposes.<br />
To see all of our products, please, use the navigation menu at the top of this page.<br />
<br />
<strong><em>Radiondistics</em> takes the uncertainty out of the invisible!</strong><br />
<br />
</p>

<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" data-valign="top" width="100%"><h1 id="welcome-to-radiondistics">Welcome to <em>Radiondistics</em> !</h1>
<p><img src="graphics/new.gif" data-valign="middle" data-align="center" data-border="0" /> Important announcement <img src="graphics/new.gif" data-valign="middle" data-align="center" data-border="0" /><br />
<br />
<br />
<br />
</p>
<p>Over the past 25 years, <em>Radiondistics</em> has led the world in the HF antenna engineering bridging the gap between the electrical engineering and the physics of the radio.<br />
<em>Radiondistics</em>' own proprietary scientific instruments have proven them-selves to be invaluable tools for handling high frequency electrical currents in a proper and rational way enabling, once again, to bridge two more physics subfields: classic electrodynamics and quantum mechanics.<br />
<br />
<strong>Thanks to <em>Francesco Errante</em>'s latest patent-pending invention</strong>, namely the "<em>high frequency sinusoidal alternating current powered gaseous core nuclear reactor for the continuous disintegration-recombination cycle of the Neon gas atoms, based on the light chemical elements non-wavelength-dependent electrical resonance physical phenomenon</em>", <strong>two leapfrog breakthrough discoveries in fundamental physics have been made, empirically demonstrated and at long last, unveiled to the public at large</strong>:</p>
<ul>
<li><p>the intrinsic electrical resonance property of light chemical element atoms, such as noble gases, with respect to high-frequency sinusoidal electrical current oscillations;</p></li>
<li><p>a non-wavelength-dependent electrical resonance phenomenon.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The interplay between the said physical property and phenomenon is responsable for the occurrence of a specific electro-nuclear process termed <em>Resonance‐Driven Disintegration‐Recombination</em> (RDDR) cycle of light elements atoms, such as those of the nobel gases.<br />
<br />
<strong>The RDDR cycle is not an identical pathway to fusion. It is a third distinct category of nuclear energy release:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p>1. Fission: Splitting heavy nuclei;</p></li>
<li><p>2. Fusion: Merging light nuclei;</p></li>
<li><p>3. RDDR (Resonance‐Driven Disintegration‐Recombination): Disassembling nuclei into a nucleon fog and reassembling them into new configurations via electrical resonance.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>Although RDDR results in the creation of new isotopes (which macroscopically resembles "fusion" if they are heavier) and release of energy, the underlying physical mechanisms, intermediate states, resonant trigger, and byproduct spectrum are categorically different from the fusion processes.<br />
<strong>RDDR is a fundamentally novel pathway indicating that rules of quantum chromodynamics (QCD) allow for a much more fluid and reversible state of nuclear matter than we currently believe</strong>.<br />
<br />
<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>I. Summary of the invention &amp; historical context</strong></p>
<p>The Gaseous-Core Resonance Reactor (Neon variant) - GCRR-N for short - represents a paradigm shift in nuclear energy, demonstrating the first functional gaseous-core reactor using non-fissile fuel. This invention resolves a technological impasse dating to the 1950s not through incremental material science, but by discovering and exploiting a previously unknown property of noble gases: their <strong>non-wavelength-dependent electrical resonance</strong> to high-frequency sinusoidal alternating current.<br />
The breakthrough originated not in a fusion laboratory, but during research into ionospheric radio propagation, where applying established direct-current quantum electrodynamic (QED) principles to a high-frequency alternating-current (AC) regime revealed a critical phenomenon.<br />
When a noble gas (e.g., neon) is subjected to a sinusoidal current oscillating at its natural electrical resonance frequency, perfect energy coupling occurs. This resonance is a function of the atoms intrinsic quantum-electrical structure, not the spatial dimensions of the apparatus or the wavelength of the driving signal.<br />
<strong>The reactor empirically validates that neon atoms possess a natural electrical resonance frequency of 27,430 kHz</strong>. Driven at this frequency within a suitably designed reaction chamber, the gas undergoes a self-sustaining cycle of atomic disintegration and statistical nuclear recombination termed <strong>Resonance-Driven Disintegration-Recombination (RDDR) Fusion</strong> producing a stable, scalable thermonuclear reaction with net energy gain.<br />
The GCRR-N demonstrates a credible and revolutionary fusion methodology. It replaces monumental heating and magnetic confinement with <strong>resonant electrostatic pumping and cyclic quantum disintegration-recombination</strong>. This represents a paradigm shift from "containing a star" to "orchestrating a continuous atomic resurrection", offering a direct path to scalable, clean, and thermally efficient power generation. The principal barrier to practical gaseous-core nuclear power was not one of engineering alone, but of fundamental oversight. By revisiting the quantum-electrical principles first explored in vacuum tubes and applying them in a novel resonant AC regime, this invention transitions gaseous-core reactors from a perpetually future concept to a present-day reality. The GCRR-Neon validates that non-fissile, non-radioactive materials can achieve net energy gain through atomic electrical resonance, and establishes RDDR Fusion as a new, viable branch of nuclear science.<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>II. The fundamental phenomenon: atomic electrical resonance in an AC field</strong></p>
<p>The phenomenon is purely quantum-mechanical and has no analogue in classical physics. Its discovery invalidated the core assumption that rendered gaseous-core reactors (GCRs) conceptual namely, that they required fissile material or unattainable plasma containment.<br />
Historically, GCRs were hamstrung by the Sisyphean challenges of fuel containment, material survival in ultra-hot plasmas, and radioactive byproduct management, all stemming from the entrenched paradigm of forcing nuclear reactions via extreme thermal kinetics or neutron flux. Critically, prior to this invention, non-fissile materials were categorically excluded as potential nuclear fuels. It was believed that neon, being an inert noble gas, could not act as a nuclear fuel. The chemical inertness of neon is a property of its filled electron shell (configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶) but is irrelevant to nuclear reactions. This is because, under conditions of high energy density and natural electrical resonance, the periodic potential of the high-frequency sinusoidal alternating current modulates the potential barrier around the nucleus, enabling the temporary capture of electrons (formation of Ne⁻) and, subsequently, the collapse of the nuclear wave function when the kinetic energy of the ions exceeds the Coulomb barrier.<br />
In other words, electrical resonance at the atomic level alters the cross-sections for low-energy nuclear interactions, an effect known in the literature as "<em>channel resonance</em>" or "<em>near-field enhancement</em>", here observed for the first time in a pure noble gas.<br />
In this regime, neon is no longer "inert": the resonance enables the disintegration of the nucleus and the instantaneous formation of thermal plasma, followed by recombination into new nuclear configurations with the release of excess binding energy.<br />
The electrical resonance of atoms a cornerstone of QED in direct-current (DC) field emission and spectroscopy had never been successfully applied or observed in a high-frequency AC regime; and consequently, the unique potential of noble gases (with their full valence shells and definable quantum states) to enter into a coherent, resonant energy absorption cycle was unrecognized by nuclear engineering.<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>The necessary conditions for the phenomenon to manifest are threefold:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p><strong>Resonant drive:</strong> A sinusoidal driving current with oscillation frequency exactly equal to the gas natural electrical resonance frequency (for neon: <strong>27,430 kHz</strong>).</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Atomic mobility:</strong> Sufficient freedom of movement low-pressure gaseous state (<strong>&lt;5 Torr</strong>).</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Energy density threshold:</strong> Environment capable of achieving critical energy density to initiate atomic and subatomic reactions.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>When satisfied, the system behaves as a perfectly resonant electrical circuit, exhibiting a sharp resonance peak within a narrow bandwidth and a stable, real-valued feed-point impedance despite the absence of any correlation with physical dimensions of the apparatus.<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>III. Reactor Design: Exploiting the Phenomenon</strong></p>
<p>The GCRR-Neon (Gaseous-Core Resonance Reactor, Neon variant) is engineered specifically to satisfy the above conditions and concentrate their effects. The reactor's heart is a unipolar electrode, fed by a single-phase, unbalanced sinusoidal alternating current and not being fixedly polarized, it cannot be designated as either cathode or anode, so it is analogously termed the <strong><em>Páno Káto</em></strong> (Greek for up and down), referencing its oscillating potential.<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>The cavity geometry creates a superposition of known concentrating effects essential for achieving the critical energy density:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p><strong>Hollow Cathode/Anode Effect:</strong> concentrates charged particles within the cavity volume.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Pendulum Effect:</strong> anions undergo repeated reflections between cavity walls and central collision zone, multiplicatively increasing kinetic energy with each half-cycle.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Electrostatic Confinement:</strong> oscillating field of the cavity walls traps charged particles, enabling sustained energy multiplication.</p></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>IV. The Disintegration-Recombination (D-R) Fusion Cycle</strong></p>
<p>The reactor initiates and maintains a continuous, two-phase nuclear process. Due to ultra-relativistic speeds, phases succeed each other cyclically and are not discernible by direct observation.</p>
<p><strong>Phase 1: Excitation &amp; Disintegration (Peak Potential)</strong></p>
<p>During each peak of the AC half-cycle, the cavity walls reach maximum negative potential. Neutral neon atoms in contact with the walls conductively acquire electrons, forming anions (Ne-). These anions are electrostatically repelled from the negatively polarized walls and converge toward the region of least negative charge the geometric center of the cavity. Through the pendulum effect, their kinetic energy multiplies with each oscillation, and they undergo elastic collisions where mutual electrostatic repulsion combined with momentum reversal traps them in a cycle of increasing energy. Upon reaching the critical energy density, <strong>ultra-relativistic collisions overcome the Coulomb barrier</strong>, causing complete nuclear disintegration into a transient nucleon fog, a dense plasma of protons and neutrons. This transition is instantaneous at the systems critical energy density, explaining the absence of conventional ignition signatures.</p>
<p><strong>Phase 2: De-excitation &amp; Recombination (Trough Potential)</strong></p>
<p>As the wall potential drops, electrostatic confinement relaxes. The ultra-hot, high-pressure nucleon fog seeks lower-energy states and undergoes <strong>statistical recombination</strong> into nuclei with higher binding energy per nucleon (e.g., Neon-20  Neon-22 + protons). The excess binding energy is released as heat and light, producing the observed thermonuclear glow and the system's net energy output. Recombined neutral atoms re-enter the buffer gas region before re-initiating the cycle.<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>V. Critical Observations &amp; Signatures</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><p><strong>Instantaneous ignition:</strong> Achieved upon reaching the critical energy density from resonant pumping, without any precursor form of ignition (e.g., electrical discharges) being discernible.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Electrically silent feed:</strong> Driven by resonance and electrostatic kinetics, not bulk current flow through plasma; no impedance mismatches, transients, or electrical perturbations manifest on the feed line during operation.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Visible thermonuclear effect:</strong> Intense heat and light originate from the recombination phase of the cyclic nucleon plasma.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Stable &amp; scalable confinement:</strong> Confinement is inherently electrostatic and cyclical, governed by drive frequency and chamber geometry, making it highly controllable.</p></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>VI. Thermal energy harnessing system</strong></p>
<p>The reactor produces energy primarily as heat deposited directly into the walls of the reaction chamber cavity (the Páno Káto electrode itself), which thus functions simultaneously as reaction chamber and thermal collector.</p>
<ul>
<li><p><strong>Primary heat exchanger:</strong> A metal serpentine conduit is integrated with the external walls of the electrode.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Heat transfer loop:</strong> A heat-conducting fluid circulates through this conduit in a closed loop, transferring thermal energy to an external standard heat exchanger, with decoupling from the high-frequency electrical signal accomplished via conventional radio-frequency systems.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Critical engineering note:</strong> Efficient, active heat extraction is <strong>mandatory</strong>. Inadequate cooling will result in rapid melting of the electrode, occlusion of the reaction cavity, cessation of the fusion reaction, and the appearance of a stationary regime of total reflection on the feed line.</p></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>VII. Theoretical implications &amp; a new fusion regime</strong></p>
<p>This process defines a new regime <strong>Resonance-Driven Disintegration-Recombination (RDDR) Fusion</strong> with profound implications:</p>
<ul>
<li><p><strong>Fuel purity:</strong> The use of a single, pure noble gas (neon) is essential. Its full electron shell and defined resonance frequency allow for synchronized, coherent anion formation required for the pumping mechanism. Reactivity or isotopic inconsistency would disrupt the cycle.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Energy gain source:</strong> Primary yield comes from the exothermic recombination of nucleons into more stable nuclear configurations. Resonant electrical input is used almost exclusively for <em>pumping</em> (imparting kinetic energy), not for heating a chaotic plasma, resulting in exceptional efficiency.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Technological heritage:</strong> The invention bridges the conceptual world of 19th- and 20th-century discharge tube physics with 21st-century energy needs, fulfilling the latent potential of those early instruments. The very tools that helped humanity discover the atom and quantum mechanics were, all along, the key to a new kind of reactor.</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Theoretical framework:</strong> RDDR Fusion stands as a legitimate alternative fusion regime to the magnetic confinement fusion (MCF) and inertial confinement fusion (ICF), demonstrating that non-fissile, non-radioactive materials can serve as efficient nuclear fuels and that atomic-scale quantum resonance can be harnessed for macroscopic power generation.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>In-depth details can be found <a href="errante_gaseous_core_atomic_resonance_nuclear_reactor.htm#details">here</a>!</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td style="text-align: left;"><div class="doublespaced">
<p>Benvenuti su <strong>Radiondistics.com</strong>! Organo ufficiale di <em>RADIONDISTICS</em>, gi� <em>Radiondistics U.K.</em></p>
<p>La parola "<em>Radiondistics</em>" � un neologismo inglesizzato, nato dall'unione di due parole italiane: <em>radio</em> ed <em>ondistica</em>. <em>Radiondistics</em> significa, quindi, fisica delle onde radio.<br />
La <em>Radiondistica</em> � una nuova, ma gi� ben affermata, branca della fisica interamente sviluppata da <a href="autore.htm">Francesco Errante</a>, scopritore del comportamento elettrico del <a href="soppressore.htm"><em>dipolo hertziano</em></a> e del reale <a href="radiazione_hertziana.htm">meccanismo dei fenomeni radio-elettrici</a> e padre dell'<a href="antenna_errante_it.htm">antenna HF monopolare con terra virtuale</a>.<br />
Lo scopo principale di questo sito internet � quello di divulgare l'opera tecnico-scientifica di <em>FRANCESCO ERRANTE</em> sui fenomeni che regolano la <a href="radiazione_hertziana.htm">radiazione hertziana</a>, i <a href="trasduttori_radioelettrici.htm">trasduttori radioelettrici</a> e le <a href="linee_bilanciate.htm">linee di transmissione</a> per segnali radioelettrici. L'obiettivo primario della radio-ondistica � l'indagine sulla fisica pura delle radio onde. La <em>radiondistica</em> � una scienza esatta, ove la teoria � sempre suffragata dalle verifiche sperimentali, ovvero dalla pratica. In fisica, l'osservazione pratica dei fenomeni ispira la teoria che a sua volta porta all'ideazione ed alla realizzazione degli strumenti per le verifiche sperimentali, i cui risultati nuovamente dirigeranno la pratica ri-ispirando la teoria in un circolo infinito.<br />
La <em>radiondistica</em> era la disciplina mancante tra la radio-tecnica e la fisica. La mancanza di una tale disciplina scientifica si � protratta per quasi un secolo. La necessita' di dover svolgere indagini con rigore scientifico sulla fisica delle radio onde, � stata auspicata dallo stesso Guglielmo Marconi, gi� nel 1909, come dimostra il <a href="guglielmo_marconi_premio_nobel.htm">discorso</a> che egli ebbe a pronunciare in occasione dell'assegnazione del suo Premio Nobel per la Fisica.<br />
Gli strumenti principali impiegati in radiondistica sono l'ingegneria radio-elettrica e radio-elettronica. Molti degli apparati scientifici del portafoglio di <em>Radiondistics</em> sono anche disponibili nella versione per pronto impiego nelle radio-comunicazioni.<br />
<br />
<strong>Tutti i concetti, metodi, disegni e prodotti qui presentati sono originali e sono esclusivamente frutto del lavoro di ricerca scientifica in materia di fisica delle radio onde, condotto da <a href="autore.htm">FRANCESCO ERRANTE</a>.</strong><br />
<br />
I prodotti <em>Radiondistics</em> impiegano esclusivamente la propria tecnologia brevettata che assicura sistemi d'antenna ed attrezzatura radio-elettronica ad alta efficienza ed affidabilit� per impieghi convenzionali e speciali nelle radio-comunicazioni trans-ionosferiche civili e militari in onde corte, nonch�, per impieghi scientifici.<br />
Per prendere visione di tutti i nostri prodotti, pregasi navigare attraverso il menu in alto.<br />
<br />
<strong><em>Radiondistics</em> toglie l'incertezza dall'invisibile!</strong><br />
<br />
</p>

<td><p>Autobiographical notes by the author.</p>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p>I am an experimental physicist and radio-electronics engineer. I first encountered radio–electric transceivers at the age of eight. For over a quarter of a century, I have been engaged in a self–funded scientific research program aimed at investigating the physics of Hertzian radiation and radio-electric phenomena. Having moved to Great Britain toward the end of 1988, I returned to Italy in March 1999 due to a <a href="http://margherita-caminita.com/" target="_blank">misfortune</a> that has befallen on my family.<br />
Although not without difficulty, I continued my research in Italy, where, instead of finding support and assistance, I found the institutions associated with the maintenance of Italy's technological rachitism, especially in its depressed areas. I can't help but recall my father's words. Having served for over twenty years as an inspector general (with full office and duties) of the Agricultural Development Agency (ESA), at the regional headquarters in Palermo, he referred to it as the "<em>Agricultural Rachitism Agency</em>."<br />
<br />
<strong>Having said that</strong>, I, <em>Francesco Errante</em>, the son of the late <em>Vincenzo Errante</em> (born in 1920, a Partisan) and <em>Margherita Caminita</em>, born in Palermo on August the 18th, 1969, wish to disclose to the international intellectual community, scholars and students, technicians and radio amateurs, and all those who may benefit from this website (www.Radiondistics.com), my discoveries in the field of radio wave physics and the scientific instruments I have designed and developed for their experimental verification, as well as my products for ready-to-use application in the radio communications.</p>
</div>
<table width="100%" data-bgcolor="#B00000" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="5" data-border="0">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" height="40" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="#B00000"><p>Visit <a href="https://www.uibm.gov.it/bancadati/search.php" target="_blank">www.uibm.gov.it</a> and enter <em>Francesco Errante</em> in the search box to see all patents of mine, or verify it directly from the <strong><em>European Patent Office</em></strong> archive <a href="https://worldwide.espacenet.com/searchResults?compact=false&amp;ST=advanced&amp;IN=francesco+errante&amp;locale=en_EP&amp;DB=EPODOC&amp;PA=francesco+errante" target="_blank">HERE</a> !</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p>Many believe that research isn't done in Italy, but <strong>the truth is that a lot of research is done in Italy... quite a lot of research is being done, especially on how to steal money from the State, the European Union, and even from private citizens, with pretext of scientific research.</strong><br />
<br />
</p>
</div>
<table width="100%" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="5" data-border="0">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 50%" />
<col style="width: 50%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left;" width="30%" height="215" data-valign="top"><p><img src="images/margherita_hack_libro.jpg" data-border="0" width="150" height="215" /></p></td>
<td style="text-align: left;" width="70%" height="215" data-valign="top"><p><strong>Free Science in free State<br />
by <em>Margherita Hack</em>,<br />
Edizione Rizzoli.</strong></p>
<p>Not only are we among the last in Europe in scientific subjects, but when we manage to train a true genius, we usually hand him a suitcase and send him abroad to do gooding. Why doesn't research in Italy really want to work? For two reasons, both deeply rooted in national history and customs. On the one hand, we suffer from a chronic and inexplicable fear of science and its potential, and from the Galileo case to the battle against preimplantation embryo analysis, much of the blame lies with the Church and its habit of dictating the law in a country that professes to be secular. On the other hand, there's the state, which from right to left cuts university funding, wastes scarce resources, and messes up academic careers without, however, managing to wrest them from the "barons." Thus, while the importance of innovation for the country's growth is extolled everywhere, in reality, those who should be producing it are hindered by every means: cumbersome competitions, lifelong precarious employment, starvation wages, and, why not, conscientious objection. Stories of ordinary contradictions in a failing system. Margherita Hack dedicates this book to analyzing the conditions of research that no longer has either State or Church to rely on. She examines the reforms that have taken place under four governments, denounces the recurring errors and too many inconsistencies, highlights the positive examples encountered throughout her career, and finally offers some ideas.<br />
<br />
</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table width="100%" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="5" data-border="0">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 50%" />
<col style="width: 50%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left;" width="261" data-valign="top"><img src="images/paul_dirac.jpg" data-hspace="10" data-vspace="0" data-border="0" width="261" height="326" alt="Paul Dirac, Nobel prize laureate" />
<p><strong>Paul Adrien Maurice Dirac, Nobel prize in physics, year 1933</strong></p></td>
<td style="text-align: left;" width="330" data-valign="top"><p>"<em>I don't understand why we keep talking about religion"</em> Paul Dirac once said.<br />
<em>If we are honest – and as scientists, we must be – we must admit that any religion is a mixture of false assertions, devoid of any basis in reality. The very idea of God is a product of man's imagination. I fully understand that primitive man, more exposed to the overwhelming forces of nature, personified these forces, driven by fear. But today, when we know so many natural phenomena, we no longer need these solutions. I assure you that I cannot see how postulating the existence of an omnipotent God can be of any use to us. What I understand is that such hypotheses lead to nothing but sterile questions, such as why God allows so much misery and injustice, the exploitation of the poor by the rich, and all the other horrors or evils that He could have easily avoided? If religion is still passed down, we know It';s very well that this happens, not because religion convinces us, but to keep the subaltern classes calm. It is easier to dominate fearful peoples than dissatisfied ones who protest; and it is also easier to exploit them. It has already been said: religion is like a kind of opium: people are lulled by visionary dreams, forgetting real injustices and exploitation. Hence the alliance between the two great political forces of the State and the Church. Both find it convenient the illusion that a good God rewardsï¿½ if not in this world, then in the nextï¿½those who have not risen up against injustice but who have submitted docilely and perhaps gratefully to the duties imposed on them. And this is why honestly asserting that God is only a figment of the human imagination is considered the worst of all mortal sins."</em><br />
<br />
</p></td>
</tr>

</table>
<table data-align="center" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="10" width="600" data-border="0" data-bgcolor="#FC6C6F">

</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-valign="top"><div class="doublespaced">
<p><strong>Italian university to join the race for actively damaging the image of the scientific research in Italy!</strong></p>
<p><strong>Overwhelmingly enthusiastic boffins<br />
managed to make a world-wide<br />
unvoluntary hoax announcement.</strong></p>
<p>Naïve theoreticians from the Department of physics and astronomy of the University of Padua and the <em>Swedish Institute of Space Physics</em> have covered themselves with ridicule after claiming they have found a way to force photons to follow an helicoidal trajectory in the free space, in a circular-vortex-like fashion, by simply getting a conventionally generated plain wavefront to bounce back off a portion of a purposefully distorted paraboloidal reflector (pictured below).<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><img src="images/bended_reflector.jpg" width="580" height="473" alt="Alcuni teorici naïve del Dipartimento di fisica ed astronomia dell&#39;Universita&#39; di Padova e dell&#39;&lt;em&gt;Istituto svedese di fisica spaziale&lt;/em&gt; si sono coperti di ridicolo dopo aver rivendicato di aver trovato il modo per forzare i fotoni a seguire una traiettoria elicoidale a guisa di vortice circolare, nello spazio libero, facendo semplicemente rimbalzare un fronte d&#39;onda piano, convenzionalmente generato da una porzione di un riflettore paraboloidale " /></p>
<p><img src="images/bended_reflector_sketch.jpg" width="580" height="179" alt="Alcuni teorici naïve del Dipartimento di fisica ed astronomia dell&#39;Universita&#39; di Padova e dell&#39;&lt;em&gt;Istituto svedese di fisica spaziale&lt;/em&gt; si sono coperti di ridicolo dopo aver rivendicato di aver trovato il modo per forzare i fotoni a seguire una traiettoria elicoidale a guisa di vortice circolare, nello spazio libero, facendo semplicemente rimbalzare un fronte d&#39;onda piano, convenzionalmente generato da una porzione di un riflettore paraboloidale " /></p>
<p>They have also claimed that by doing so, a number of radio carrier signals having identical frequency could travel on the same path and direction by means of circular vortex-like trajectory differing from each other only by the phase of their vortex, each carrying a different set of informations, thus obtaining more channels in the same frequency.<br />
<strong>According to the informations I gathered, they have conducted some seriously ill-conceived and ill-deviced experiments with the assistance of a few italian radio amateurs, instead of hiring proper microwave engineers.<br />
Owing to their lack of competence and expertise, the italo-swedish Team has blatantly failed to comprehend the results and its own mistakes. Needless to say: their "experiment" on the venetian lagoon turned out to be a fiasco!</strong></p>
</div></td>

<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%" height="10" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="#FFFFFF"></td>
</tr>

<table data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="5" width="100%" data-border="0">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><p><strong>A VIRTUAL GROUND BALUN FOR THE SUPPRESSION OF ANY WHICH ONE OF THE TWO BRANCHES OF AN � A WAVELENGTH OPEN DIPOLE ANTENNA</strong></p>
<p>by <em>Francesco Errante</em></p>
<p><strong>Scientific purposes :</strong></p>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p><strong>a.</strong> The balun described hereby enables to demonstrate that the � wavelength open dipole antenna, also known as "<em>Hertzian Dipole</em>" is not an "<em>elementary antenna</em>" (by definition an elementary antenna is an aerial where the condition of resonance and radiation cannot take place without the presence of all its parts) but it is, instead, an "<em>elementary array</em>" of 2 radiating/captating elements of a physical length equal to � of a wavelength each, which are electrically arranged in a counterphase, while being fed in the middle of them;<br />
<strong>(The same happens with all the other symmetric dipoles, regardless of their impedance, also known as <em>radiation resistance</em>.)</strong><br />
<br />
<strong>b.</strong> The balun described hereby enables to demonstrate that once a virtual ground node is available, it is possible to receive and transmit radio-electric signals through the space by employing a single radiating/captating element of a physical length equal to � of a wavelength, without the need for a natural nor an artificial ground plane; (see --&gt; <a href="antenna_errante.htm"><em>ERRANTE's ANTENNA</em></a> )<br />
<br />
<strong>c.</strong> The balun described hereby enables to demonstrate that each of the two branches of an � wavelength open dipole antenna, at its frequency of resonance, exhibits an absolute impedance value of 35 Ohm, unbalanced and referred to the virtual ground node;<br />
<strong>(Likewise, any which one of the two branches of any other symmetric dipole will yeld a characteristic impedance value equal to � of the impedance of the dipole to which it belongs.)</strong><br />
<br />
<strong>d.</strong> The balun described hereby enables to demonstrate that each of the two branches of an � wavelength open dipole antenna, exhibits a phase-angle difference of +/- 90 degree with respect to the virtual ground node.<br />
<br />
<strong>e.</strong> <u>The balun described hereby, by allowing to suppress anyone of the two branches of the dipole, has led to confute, once and for all, the "<em>theory of the antenna image</em> "</u> .</p>
<p><strong>Circuit description</strong><br />
<br />
In the field of radio-engineering, a multitude of systems are well-known for matching an � wavelength open dipole to an unbalanced transmission line, they are usually referred to as <em>balun</em> (a compound term meaning "balanced-unbalanced"). State of the art balun(s) do not allow feeding of the two branches of an � wavelength open dipole independently from each other and as a result of that, they do not allow to verify whether it possible to suppress anyone of them without interfering with the condition of resonance and irradiation of the remaining one. <strong>The invention described hereby allows to feed each of the two branches of an � wavelength open dipole independently, so that they can become electrically independent from each other allowing, therefore, to suppress anyone of them without repercussions on the condition of resonance and radiation of the remaining one.</strong><br />
(<a href="balun_300.htm">similarly, a device for splitting up the � a wavelength folded dipole antenna is described here</a>)<br />
<br />
</p>
<table data-bordercolor="#000000" data-bordercolorlight="#000000" data-bordercolordark="#000000" data-border="1" width="400" height="245" data-cellpadding="0" data-cellspacing="0" data-align="center">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="400" height="245"><img src="schematics/suppressor.jpg" width="400" height="245" alt="VIRTUAL GROUND OPEN DIPOLE BRANCH SUPPRESSOR" /></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>This result has been achieved by means of a lumped-constants radio-electric circuit, based around a broad-band radio-frequency electric transformer(1) winded on a binocular type ferrite core having a primary winding(2) exhibiting an impedance value equal the one of the transmission line(3) being used and a center-tapped secondary winding(4) exhibiting an impedance value of 35 + 35 Ohm. The said impedance values are referred to the <em>virtual ground</em>. ("virtual ground" is defined as a point in an electrical circuit that appears to be at ground, but is not actually attached to ground, it is therefore, a node having a 0 degree phase angle difference with respect to ground and has the same electrical potential as the Earth")<br />
<br />
The virtual ground node has been obtained by providing the transformer's secondary winding(4) with a center-tap(5), effectively splitting the secondary winding in two sections. The virtual ground is then made available to the whole of the network by a short electrical connection(6) to the device conductive chassis(7).<br />
The transformer's working point is optimized by compensation with the employment of high-voltage RF duty capacitors(8).<br />
<br />
The suppression of one of the two branches of the open dipole is made by manually operating the high insulation resistance switch(9) diverting the radio-electric signal from the transformer(1) off the branch of the dipole(11 or 12) and into one lead of the non-inductive 35 Ohm dummy-load(10) while the other lead of the dummy-load is attached to the virtual ground circuit.</p>
<p><strong>The balun described hereby is characterized by being a <a href="balun_errante.htm"><strong><em>NON fluctuating impedance</em></strong></a> RF electrical transformer. All of its terminations impedance values are set by design, hence the impedance transformation ratio is a function of them and not viceversa, unlike it happens with any other balun arrangement.</strong><br />
<br />
</p>
</div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>

</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left;"><p><em>Hertzian Radiation</em>, <span class="small">(better known as radio-waves) : what it is and how it happens</span></p>
<p>by <em>Francesco Errante</em></p>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p><strong>This is a brief presentation of <em>Francesco Errante's theorem on the physics of the hertzian radiation</em></strong>.</p>
<p>The <em>hertzian radiation</em> is the oldest, yet the least common way to refer to radio-waves. It takes its name after <a href="hertz/KIT_PI_2013_153_Hertz_125_Years_Propagation_of_Electric_Action.pdf" target="_blank"><em>Heinrich Rudolf Hertz</em></a>, the first physicist and engineer to have demontrated the possibility of radio transmissions.</p>
<p>Ever since Hertz experiment and untill now, it was believed that energy would travel all the way from the transmitter to the receiver while maintaining its original form, hence, erroneously crediting electric signals with the property of being able to travel in the empty space. Hertz, him-self, named his own apparatus misterious emissions as "<em>electric waves</em>". Subsequently, they were renamed as "electromagnetic waves".<br />
<br />
First of all, it is paramount to comprehend that <strong>the <em>hertzian radiation</em> is a natural phenomenon with an artificial origin</strong>. Although, the <em>hertzian radiation</em> mirrors the nuclear reactions photonic emission mechanism, it takes place at frequencies far lower than those present in nature - eg: Sun's nuclear fusion and its radiations. See <a href="frequency_wavelength_energy_radiation_calculator.htm"><em>energy and radiation wavelength</em></a>. In nature, radiations get generated by matter's violent energy excitation which involves very high tempertures and consequentially very high frequencies. Radiations of wavelenght longer than those of the infrared rays spectrum, in nature, have no known practical function, although, they still retain scientific relevance. In the <em>hertzian radiation</em>, instead, the excitation is artificially imposed by means of <em>electric oscillation</em>.<br />
<em>Electric oscillation</em> is a means to obtain the excitation of the electric charges and it must not be confused with the <em>hertzian radiation</em> it-self! Unfortunately, this is what has been happening untill now.<br />
<br />
<strong>The purpose of this study is to demonstrate that:</strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>1) the mere oscillation of electric charges is not the phenomenon at the origin of the <em>hertzian radiation</em>;<br />
2) <em>hertzian radiation</em> can only take place following an energy transformation, named <em>radio-electric transduction</em>.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p><strong>Here is a brief introduction to the Author's logical development of his ideas, concepts, observations, deductions and <a href="scientific_index.htm">patented devices</a> leading to his findings.</strong><br />
<br />
<strong>The method.</strong><br />
<em>Simplification</em> is the main rule in the observation and understanding of physical phenomena. Simplification, though, must not be confused with a simplistic approach and it may require the development of tailor-made tools and technology which can them-selves be far from being simple.<br />
<br />
<strong>The stripping of a radiator to its bare essentials.</strong><br />
The � of a wavelength <em>open dipole antenna</em>, since its birth, has always been considered to be the most simple available antenna and therefore it has always been the specimen on which to conduct studies. Those studies, however, were ill at birth as the <em>open dipole</em> is not an aerial as simple as it looks. In addition, having considered the open dipole an "<em>elementary antenna</em>" has shifted the focus of those studies away from its essence and into its properties and its effects. Consequentially, the theories about its intimate functioning are flawed and are responsible for a number of further well radicated misconceptions. Moreover, this has prevented from establishing how the <em>hertzian radiation</em> takes place.</p>
<table data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="3" width="100%" data-border="1" data-bordercolor="#000000" data-noshade="">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><p><img src="schematics/apparato_di_hertz.gif" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" width="560" height="235" alt="Apparato di Hertz per trasmissione e ricezione radio-elettrica. Nascita del Dipolo di Hertz, 1887" /></p>
<p><strong>Hertz experiment. The apparatus for radio-electric transmission and reception. Birth of the <em>hertzian dipole antenna</em>, 1887.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>By means of a particular <a href="suppressor.htm">radio-electric circuitry for the suppression of anyone of the two branches of a � of wavelength open dipole</a>, I have demonstrated, once and for all, that the <em>open dipole</em> is not an <em>elementary antenna</em> (by definition an elementary antenna is an aerial where the condition of resonance and radiation cannot take place without the presence of all its parts) but it is, instead, an "<em>elementary array</em>" of 2 elements, of a physical length equal to � of a wavelength each, which are electrically arranged in a counterphase, while being fed in the middle of them.<br />
<br />
Once it has been established that the focus should be placed on the behavior of a single element of physical length equal to � of wavelength, further research has allowed me to come up with a truly "<em><a href="antenna_errante.htm">elementary radiator</a></em>" to further distinguish between the source of the radio-electric signal and the actual radiator.<br />
<br />
The <em>elementary radiator</em>, infact, comprises a radio-electric circuitry and a � of wavelength radiator which can be easily detached and substituted by a dummy load (anti-inductive load), in order to conduct RF measurement on the circuitry alone, while, radio-scopic observations of the actual radiator emissions can be carried out by means of a particular <a href="detector.htm">detector</a> which exploits and, at the meantime, demonstrates the phenomenon of the <em>radioluminescence</em> from secondary ionization induced by <em>hertzian radiation</em>.<br />
<br />
<strong>The radio-scopic observation by <em>radioluminescence</em></strong>.<br />
By employing my <a href="detector_it.htm">detector</a>, I have carried out several non-intrusive radio-scopic measurements on the radiator over the full spectrum of the shortwaves, anywhere between 1 and 30 MHz with an RF power ranging from 100 mW to several kiloWatt.</p>
<p><strong>The experiments I have deviced ed carried out, clearly, demonstrate that:</strong></p>
<p>1) the energy radiated by the radiator has a transitory ionizing power;</p>
<p>2) by injecting a radio-electric signal into a properly resonant radiator, the latter will always radiate energy as radio waves, starting from the point which is always opposite to the point of feeding;</p>
<p>3) that the bulk of the energy is always radiated by the region towards the end of the radiator..</p>
<table data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="3" width="100%" data-border="0" data-bgcolor="yellow">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><img src="photos/errante_1st_law.jpg" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" width="593" height="442" alt="Experimental verification of the Ist. Errante&#39;s law by radiofluorescence" /></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" height="90" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="yellow"><p><strong>Demonstration of the I<sup>st</sup> Errante's law by radioluminescence.</strong></p>
<p><strong><br />
The image above shows the energy distribution on an half wave folded dipole and on an half wave open dipole, both in a condition of resonance, while being fed with two RF signals of equal amplitude and wave length.<br />
It is observed how on the first case the light emission reaches its maximum intensity in the middle of the dipole while on the second case the light emission reaches its maximum intensity towards the ends of the dipole.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" height="90" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="yellow"><p><strong>I<sup><u><span class="small">st.</span></u></sup> Errante's law</strong>: any radio-frequency electric signal or any radio-frequency electric impulse that is injected onto any electrical conductor of any shape, <strong>will ALWAYS give origin</strong> to hertzian radiation starting from the point opposite to that of feeding.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>Radio-electric measurements and radio-scopic counterverification.</strong><br />
Conversely, <a href="balanced_lines.htm">further measurements</a> have allowed to verify the <strong>absence of hertzian radiation on conductors (transmission lines) while in a progressive wave regime.</strong></p>
<table data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="3" width="100%" data-border="0" data-bgcolor="yellow">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><img src="photos/bal-bal/dipole_no_line_radiation_high_power_sideview.jpg" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" width="593" height="210" alt="Experimental verification of the IInd Errante&#39;s law by radiofluorescence" /></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><img src="photos/errante_2nd_law.jpg" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" width="593" height="140" alt="Experimental verification of the IInd Errante&#39;s law by radiofluorescence" /></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" height="90" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="yellow"><p><strong>Demonstration of the II<sup>nd</sup> Errante's law by radioluminescence.</strong></p>
<p><strong><br />
The images above show the absence of hertzian radiation on a balanced transmission line, in a progressive wave regime, while being runned with a 1000 Watt RF signal. Either terminated on a reactive or a non-inductive load.<br />
<br />
Power: 1 KW RF<br />
Test frequency on the dipole: 25,5 Mhz<br />
Test frequency on a dummy load: from 1.8 MHz to 30 Mhz in 100 KHz steps<br />
<a href="balanced_lines.htm">Go to the experimental verification page</a></strong></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" height="90" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="yellow"><p><strong>II<sup><u><span class="small">nd.</span></u></sup> Errante's law</strong>: any radio-frequency electric signal or any radio-frequency electric impulse that is injected onto any electrical conductor of any shape properly terminated onto a load having an impedance value equal to that of its source, <strong>will NEVER give origin</strong> to hertzian radiation.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>Author's deductions.</strong><br />
What has just been said, reasonably, leads to affirm that the <strong>hertzian radiation takes place whenever charges belonging to a first wavefront having flowed forth along the radiator all the way up to its end, return backwards and hit a new forthcoming wavefront giving origin to collisions with scattering of particles, most likely to be photons, having the same frequency and wave form of the radio-electric signal that has generated it. As it is impossible for the new particles to travel faster than light, the particles will acquire more mass instead.</strong> (if particles could travel faster then light, their emission would, inevitably, end-up generating shorter wavelength radio signals)</p>
<p><strong>This mechanism is, therefore, a form of <em>controlled or limited standing wave regime</em>, if it happens within the length of the radiator then we have <em>resonance</em>, if it exceeds the length of the radiator we have a <em>random standing wave regime</em> with less or no radiation</strong>.</p>
<table width="100%" data-align="center" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="10" data-border="0" data-bgcolor="yellow">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><img src="images/feynman_diagram.gif" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" data-border="0" width="530" height="300" alt="Feynman diagram applied to the radio-electric transduction" /></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><p><strong>In the hertzian radiation mechanism, the <em>antiparticle</em> is nothing else than an electron flowing back in the opposite direction to the one it was initially injected from.<br />
<u>Hence, the minus sign of one of the two <em>Dirac's equation</em> solutions indicates the negative direction of the particle and not a negative charge of it</u>!<br />
<br />
<em>Errante</em>'s radio-electric transduction mechanism is fully consistent with <em>Prof. John Archibald Wheeler</em>'s own intuition as aknowledged by</strong> <a href="richard_feynman_nobel_lecture.htm#p"><strong><em>Richard Feynman</em> in his Nobel lecture</strong></a><strong>.<br />
<br />
Moreover, evidence shows that the <em>law of conservation of energy</em> holds true, while leaves no room for keeping on theorizing about the <em>positron</em> and the <em>antimatter</em>.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%" height="30"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table width="100%" data-align="center" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="10" data-border="0" data-bgcolor="pink">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><p><strong>Conclusions:<br />
<br />
according to this Author's findings, the physical mechanism responsible for the generation of the <em>hertzian radiation</em> is different from what it was previously theorized and accepted as true.<br />
<br />
The forecast of a concatenation between the electric field and the magnetic one, as offered by Maxwell's equations, describe the electric and the magnetic fields engaged in an endless cycle of mutual creation. This interpretation bears a fundamental error which lies in the fact that the concatenation between fields was thought to be in the fashion of an overlaying and NOT in a relay-race like full-cycle progression as it happens to be, instead.<br />
<br />
In the light of this Author's findings, it can be affirmed that there is no such a thing as an electromagnetic wave, an electromagnetic field or an electromagnetic signal. There are, instead, photonic emissions (radio waves) that follow the same wave form and frequency of the signals that have generated them, capable of inducing electromotive forces onto the matter with the same frequency and wave form.<br />
<br />
As a direct consequence of this findings, when it comes to radio-electric transduction, the concept of <em>electromagnetic induction</em> does no longer hold true, either. Accordingly, the mechanism by which an electrical conductor (ie: radio antenna) gets affected by the <em>hertzian radiation</em> must be different from what it was previously thought too and everything points to nothing else than a simple <em>photovoltaic effect</em>, just as observed by <em>Hertz</em> and <em>Hallwachs</em> in the ultraviolet radiation spectrum.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%" height="30"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="10" width="100%" data-border="0" data-bgcolor="yellow">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: left;" width="100%"><p><strong>The transmission and reception of a radio-electric signal, from a point to another of the empty space, is not, therefore, a simple transfer of energy in the same form and the radio-frequency electric signals do not have the property of travelling in the empty space.</strong></p>
<table data-align="center" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="10" width="90%" data-border="1" data-bordercolor="#000000" data-bgcolor="pink">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><p><strong>Errante's principle on the <em>radio-electric transmission</em><br />
<br />
For a given quantity of energy, in the form of a radio-frequency electric signal, to flow from a point to another of the empty space, to be later reproduced in its original form, it is necessary that the said energy undergoes at least two transformation:<br />
<br />
1<sup><span class="small">st</span></sup> from radio-frequency electric signal to hertzian radiation;<br />
2<sup><span class="small">nd</span></sup> from hertzian radiation back to radio-frequency electric signal.<br />
<br />
The minimum number of two transductions it's what it takes in the case of a direct line-of-sight radio propagation.</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>This particular phenomenon involving an energy transformation of a radio-frequency electric signal into a radio-frequency radiation and viceversa, is called <em>radio-electric transduction</em>. The <em>radio-electric transduction</em> is a spontaneous phenomenon where an ordained form of energy gets transformed into a disordered one with a different form and viceversa. This transformations can be repeated an infinite number of times but with regard to energy loss it is an highly disadvantageous exercice.</strong></p>
<p><strong>The devices capable of enhancing the <em>radio-elettric transduction</em>, are defined as</strong> <a href="radioelectric_transducers.htm"><em>radio-eletctric transducers</em></a> <strong>and are commonly known as "radio antennas".</strong></p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><img src="graphics/new.gif" data-align="left" /> Please, take a look at our new all-in-one apparatus for the physics of the hertzian radiation and the radio-electric transducers. <a href="errante_apparatus.htm">Here !</a></p>
</div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></td>

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><p><strong>ERRANTE's ANTENNA</strong> : what it is, how it works and how it came to be made.</p>
<p><strong>VIRTUAL GROUND � of wavelength MONOPOLE (HF) ANTENNA</strong><br />
<br />
by <em>Francesco Errante</em></p>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p>The Author, by means of a particular <a href="suppressor.htm">radio-electric circuitry</a> for the suppression of anyone of the two branches of a � of wavelength open dipole, has previously demonstrated that, indeed, it is possible to receive and above all, transmit large radio-electric signals across the space by employing a single radiating/captating element of a physical length equal to � of wavelength, without the necessity of the presence of its symmetric (see <em>Hertzian Dipole</em> ) or the necessity of a natural ground plane (see <em>Marconi's Antenna</em> ) or an artificial one made of radials or counterpoises as in the <em>Ground Plane Antenna</em>. The need to have the Earth or another artificial ground as an electric reference point to correctly polarize a single resonant radiator/captator of a physical length equal to � of a wavelength, has been eliminated by generating a <em>virtual ground node</em>, the existence of which is function of the precise balancing of the of a broad-band RF transformer. ("virtual ground" is defined as a point in an electrical circuit that appears to be at ground, but is not actually attached to ground, it is therefore, a node having a 0 degree phase angle difference with respect to ground and has the same electrical potential as the Earth")<br />
This method, however, implied a 50% dissipation of the system energy.<br />
<br />
<strong>The invention described hereby eliminates the need for sacrificing any of the system energy by exploiting the very same physical principal of the <em>virtual ground node</em></strong>.<br />
<br />
</p>
<table data-bordercolor="#000000" data-bordercolorlight="#000000" data-bordercolordark="#000000" data-border="1" width="440" height="235" data-cellpadding="0" data-cellspacing="0" data-align="center">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="460" height="236"><img src="schematics/antenna_errante.jpg" width="460" height="236" alt="VIRTUAL GROUND HF MONOPOLE ANTENNA - Antenna Errante" /></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>The solution to that problem is given by the possibility of generating the <em>virtual ground node</em> by recombining two radio-electric signals, identical but 180 degree out of phase between them-selves.</strong> This can be achieved by employing a broad-band flux-coupled balun transformer(9) built around a binocular type ferrite core, having a center-tapped balanced primary winding(11) for the obtainment of the said <em>virtual ground node</em> to be used as a zero-potential reference point for the whole of the circuit, through the conductive chassis(10) and having also a secondary winding(13) exhibiting an impedance value of 150 Ohm for the direct coupling to a � of a wavelength radiator/captator(1).<br />
The transformer(9) and the radiator/captator(1) are the essential parts of the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND � of wavelength MONOPOLE ANTENNA</em>, they alone, infact, constitute a � of wavelength monopole antenna with balanced input. However, in order for it to match the current transmission line standards, it has been necessary to provide it with a second transformer(5) capable of adapting the unbalanced coaxial antenna output of a conventional transceiver to the balanced input of this antenna transformer(9). The virtual ground node(6), obtained on the secondary winding of the transformer(5), is made available to the circuit through the conductive chassis(4).<br />
The RF energy transfer between the two transformers(5 &amp; 9) is accomplished by the <a href="balanced_lines.htm">twinned coaxial transmission lines</a>(7) which can be of any length but must be identical between them-selves so not to alter the original phase-angle difference between the RF signals they are meant to be carrying. Although, the value of impedance of the intermedium circuit, which comprises the primary winding of the transformer(9), the <a href="balanced_lines.htm">twinned coaxial lines</a>(7) and the secondary winding of the transformer(5) can be set to any value, it turned out to be convenient adopting a standard value of 50 Ohm.<br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>Following the publication of the</strong> <a href="balanced_lines.htm"><strong>studies on the behaviour of a balanced transmission line in a progressive wave regime</strong></a><strong>, a variant to the virtual ground monopole HF antenna is disclosed here below:</strong></p>
<table data-bordercolor="#000000" data-bordercolorlight="#000000" data-bordercolordark="#000000" data-border="1" width="460" height="236" data-cellpadding="0" data-cellspacing="0" data-align="center">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="460" height="236"><img src="schematics/antenna_errante_open_wire_balanced_transmission_line.jpg" width="460" height="236" alt="A variant of the VIRTUAL GROUND HF MONOPOLE ANTENNA using an open wire balanced transmission line - Antenna Errante" /></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>It is of a paramount importance that the impedance of local transformer's(5) secondary winding, the impedance of the open wire balanced transmission line(7b) and the impedance of the remote transformer's(9) primary winding be exactly the same.</strong><br />
<br />
</p>
<p><strong>Scientific relevance:</strong></p>
<table data-bordercolor="#000000" data-bordercolorlight="#000000" data-bordercolordark="#000000" data-border="0" width="400" data-cellpadding="5" data-cellspacing="0" data-align="center">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="400"><div class="doublespaced">
<p>a. it demonstrates that a single electrically conductive element of a physical length equal to � of wavelength is all it takes to accomplish natural resonance and full radiation.<br />
<br />
b. thanks to its most elementary shape and bare simplicity of the radiating element, it allows further investigation into the physics of the radiowaves. (see <a href="hertzian_radiation.htm">here</a>)</p>
</div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>Operational advantages:</strong></p>
<table data-border="0" width="400" data-cellpadding="5" data-cellspacing="0" data-align="center">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="400"><div class="doublespaced">
<p>a. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> demonstrates that, indeed, it is possible and relatively inexpensive to implement an highly efficient way to better radiate RF energy while cutting by 50% the room needed to deploy a full-size HF antenna.<br />
<br />
b. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers a much larger bandwidth compared to conventional full-size aerials.<br />
<br />
c. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers a much stronger immunity to parasitic capacitive effects compared to conventional full-size aerials.<br />
<br />
d. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers high resonance stability regardless of the level and inclination above the ground.<br />
<br />
e. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers a much stronger immunity to out-of-band emissions compared to conventional full-size aerials.<br />
<br />
f. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers a much stronger immunity to electrostatic charges and noises compared to conventional full-size aerials.<br />
<br />
g. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers a sharper radiation pattern than conventional full-size aerials.<br />
<br />
h. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers a much faster deployment time compared to conventional full-size aerials.<br />
<br />
i. the <em>VIRTUAL GROUND MONOPOLE HF ANTENNA</em> offers a much better E.M.I. compatibility with highly populated environments compared to conventional full-size aerials.</p>
</div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td style="text-align: left;" width="80%" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="#FFFFFF"><table data-border="0" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="5" width="100%" data-align="center">

<tr>
<td><p>�</p>
<h1 id="the-radio-electric-transducers-better-known-as-radio-antennas-in-the-light-of-the-new-discoveries.">The radio-electric transducers, better known as <em>radio antennas</em>, in the light of the new discoveries.</h1>
<p>by <em>Francesco Errante</em></p>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p>In physics, by the word "<em>transducers</em> ", we define all of those devices capable of transforming a form of energy into another one and vice-versa. Generally, during the transformation performed by the transducers, an ordained form of energy gets transformed into a disordered one and vice-versa. As an example: loudspeakers and microphones are electro-mechanical transducers. They, infact, transform electric energy into mechanical vibrations and vice-versa. Radio antennas are, instead, "<em>radio-electric transducers</em>", they transform radio-frequency electric energy into <a href="hertzian_radiation.htm"><em>hertzian radiation</em> (radio-waves)</a> and vice-versa.<br />
Unlike what happens with other types of transducers, understanding how radio-electric transducers work cannot be done by intuition. That's because they have no machanical parts in motion and their "vibrations" cannot be directly perceived by the human body. To tell the truth, under certain conditions (frequency, power and distance from the source), the human body can feel some of the effects of the <em>hertzian radiation</em>, as a distributed heat or a localized burn, but this was not enough to discover the real mechanism at the origins of the <em>radio waves'</em> phenomenon.<br />
For more than a century and indeed, ever since <em>Heinrich Hertz</em> demonstrated the existence of the radio-electric phenomena, their "scientific" description has been limited to a mere theoretical representation by mathematics. In the year 2003, the Author has, letterally and definitely, shed some light on the real mechanism at the origins of the <em>hertzian radiation</em>, by means of his own particular <a href="detector.htm">detection system</a> based on the <em>radioluminescence</em>, another physical phenomenon of energy transformation.<br />
Untill recent, the radio-electric transdusers have been divided in two main types: the balanced and the un-balanced ones.<br />
<strong>In the ligth of</strong> <a href="suppressor.htm"><strong>what the Author has demonstrated</strong></a><strong>, the said division should now be revised. Accordingly, the radio-electric transdusers should be distinguished in two categories: the "<em>elementary</em> " ones and the "<em>NON-elementary</em> " ones.</strong><br />
(by definition an <em>elementary radio-electric transducer</em> is a transducer where the condition of resonance and radiation cannot take place without the presence of all its parts)<br />
The elementary radio-electric transducers are <em><a href="antenna_errante_it.htm">monopolos</a></em> (un-balanced antennas), while the NON-elementary ones are <em>dipoles</em> (balanced antennas). Both types of transducers can be <em>open ended</em> or closed circuits as <em>loops</em>. <u>It has to be clarified that <em>loops</em> are, also, often improperly referred to as "folded". This is incorrect as, in radio-engineering, it is possible to have folded antennas that are electrically open</u>.<br />
<em>Dipoles</em> can be <em><a href="suppressor.htm">open dipoles</a></em> or of a closed circuit type, incorrectly called "<em>folded dipoles</em>". However, the latter is the father of all the <a href="balun_300.htm"><em>loops</em></a>. The <em>folded dipole</em>, <a href="balun_300.htm">as demonstrated</a>, can be traced back to two closed-circuit monopoles fed in a counter-phase arrangement and physically coinciding with each other. This is, also, true for <em>loops</em> having any geometry (e.g. circular, delta-loop, polygonal etc.).<br />
<strong>Any NON-elementary radio-electric transducer (balanced transducers) can always been traced back to a system of elementary transducers (unbalanced transdusers) being arranged in a counterphase configuration.</strong><br />
The incorrect spacing-up between elementary radio sources belonging to the same system will give origin to <a href="self_antagonist.htm">self-antagonist systems</a> to the detriment of the <em>antenna's gain</em>.</p>
</div></td>
</tr>

<td style="text-align: left;" width="80%" data-valign="top" data-bgcolor="#FFFFFF"><p>Errante's apparatus<br />
for the physics of the balanced transmission lines for radio frequency signals.</p>
<table width="600" data-bgcolor="#000000" data-border="0" data-cellspacing="1" data-cellpadding="0">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><table width="598" data-bgcolor="#FFFFFF" data-border="0" data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="10">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><div class="doublespaced">
<p><strong>Foreword: although when referring to balanced transmission lines our thougth goes to a pair of identical electrical conductors beign parallel to each other, commonly known as a "<em>bifilar line</em>" , it must be said that balanced transmission lines can also be formed by any even number of conductors carrying the same number of currents in a multi-phases arrangement. (Poly-phase currents arrangement were first introduced in the electrical engineering by <em>Nikola Tesla</em>)<br />
Balanced transmission lines can be either <em>symmetric</em> or <em>asymmetric</em>.</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
<p><strong><u>Definition of a balanced transmission line</u>: � "<em>a transmission line for electric signals is electrically balanced when it does not intervene to modify the phase difference between the currents traveling on it and each and every of its conductors transfer the same amount of energy per time unit (power).</em>"</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
<p><strong><u>Definition of a <em>symmetric</em> balanced transmission line</u>: � "<em>an electrically balanced transmission line for electric signals is symmetric when it is formed by electrical conductors which exhibit the same impedance value with respect to the physical ground or to a virtual ground node.</em>"</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
<p><strong><u>Definition of an <em>asymmetric</em> balanced transmission line</u>: "<em>an electrically balanced transmission line for electric signals is asymmetric when it is formed by electrical conductors which DO NOT exhibit the same impedance value with respect to the physical ground or to a virtual ground node.</em>"</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
<p><strong><u>I<sup><span class="small">st</span></sup> <em>Errante</em>'s principle for the transmission lines</u>: � "<em>a transmission line for radioelectric signals, being it balanced or unbalanced, when in a progressive wave regime, is always aperiodic</em>."</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
<p><strong><u>II<sup><span class="small">nd</span></sup> <em>Errante</em>'s principle for the transmission lines</u>: "<em>any transmission line for radioelectric signals, may be converted from being a balanced one to an unbalanced one and viceversa, an infinite number of times</em>."</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
<p><strong><u>III<sup><span class="small">rd</span></sup> <em>Errante</em>'s principle for the transmission lines</u>: "<em>it is always possible to generate a virtual ground node anywhere along a transmission line for radioelectric signals</em> ."</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
<p><strong><u>II<sup><span class="small">nd</span></sup> <em>Errante</em>'s law applied to the transmission lines</u> "<em>a transmission line for radioelectric signals, being it balanced or unbalanced, when in a progressive wave regime, does not originate hertzian radiation</em>."</strong></p>
<p><strong><em>Francesco Errante</em></strong></p>
</div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>�</p>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p><strong>The apparatus and the measurement method presented hereby permit to analyze the electric behaviour of balanced transmission lines for radio frequency electric segnals in a progressive wave regime and in particular have the purpose of:<br />
<br />
a) demonstrating that the balanced transmission lines are aperiodic;<br />
<br />
b) demonstrating that the balanced transmission lines can be converted into unbalanced ones and viceversa, an infinite number of times;<br />
<br />
c) demonstrating that it is always possible to generate a virtual ground node at any point of any transmission line;<br />
<br />
d) demonstrating that the balanced transmission lines, when perfectly matched, both to the signal source and to the load, DO NOT originate hertzian radiation. �<a href="hertzian_radiation.htm"><strong>II<sup><span class="small">nd</span></sup> Errante's law</strong></a>.</strong></p>
<p>�</p>
</div>
<table data-cellspacing="0" data-cellpadding="5" width="100%" data-border="0" data-bgcolor="#D28664">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><img src="photos/bal-bal/balbal_linearity_test_header.jpg" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" width="593" height="188" alt="Errante&#39;s balanced-to-balanced measurement test set being checked for frequency response flatness" /></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><img src="photos/bal-bal/balbal_test-set_2.jpg" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" width="593" height="66" alt="S.W.R. measurement on a 300 Ohm balanced transmission line terminated onto a 300 Ohm reactive balanced load" /></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="100%"><img src="photos/bal-bal/unbalun_header.jpg" data-align="center" data-hspace="0" data-vspace="0" width="593" height="188" alt="Errante&#39;s 300/300 Ohm balanced virtual ground node generator being checked for frequency response flatness" /></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>�</p>
<div class="doublespaced">
<p>The balanced transmission lines for radio frequency electric signals are generally formed omogeneously by two identical unshielded electrical conductors running parallel to each other but can also be formed by a larger number of conductors, being them open wires or shielded cables. �</p>
</div>

<tr>

<p>�</p>

<tr>
<td style="text-align: center;" width="486" height="231"><a href="capacitive_grounding.htm"><img src="schematics/errante_one-wire_transmission_line.jpg" data-vspace="0" data-hspace="0" data-border="0" width="486" height="231" alt="Errante&#39;s capacitive RF earth grounding system applied to the RF transmission line" /></a></td>
